title: layia calliglossa
intro: Layia calliglossa, commonly known as Mountain Goldfields, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly for its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The health benefits of Layia calliglossa include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include sesquiterpene lactones and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
